01 · Controls

How to Fly

Four inputs run the whole ship. Steering is continuous — drag, mouse, keys all feed the same line — and everything else is one press away. Sound is synthesized live: an engine hum and effects generated with Web Audio, no audio files.

W A S D ↑ ← ↓ →

Steer

Drag on the screen, move the mouse, or hold the arrow keys / WASD. The ship follows your line through the glyph columns — thread shards through the nose.

SPACE SHIFT BOOST ⏺

Boost

Hold the on-screen BOOST button, Shift, or Space to burn boost. Boost drains as you use it — data shards recharge it. Faster ship, faster danger.

PAUSE ⏸

Pause

The Pause toggle freezes the run where it stands. Speed, stream and sentinels all hold until you resume.

SOUND ♪

Sound

The Sound toggle controls the synthesized Web Audio mix — the engine hum under the run and the effects for shards, boosts and impacts.

Feel the steering

Tap the pad, then steer with WASD or the arrow keys — the same keys the game reads. Hold Space or Shift and the boost keys light amber, just like the real HUD lighting up under your hands.

02 · Matrix AI

A Co-Pilot, Not a Menu

The AI integration in STARWAKE is a live co-pilot — a crew member riding the run with you. It reads how you fly and acts on it in real time, in four specific ways.

/01

It calls the run

A live ticker under the action narrates the run as it happens — shards banked, streaks, near misses, impacts — called like a spotter who can see the whole stream.

/02

It warns before the hull fails

Threat callouts fire while there is still time to fix them — low-integrity warnings arrive early enough to route through shards and patch the ship before a failure, not after one.

/03

It adapts the stream to you

Fly clean and the co-pilot raises sentinel node density — the stream tightens because you can take it. Take hits and it does the opposite: extra shards get routed into your lane so you can repair.

/04

It writes your debrief

At game over, the co-pilot writes a run debrief from your actual stats — how you flew, what the stream did to you, and what ended the run.

Matrix AI ▸ Co-Pilot Live
Run start “First shards inbound. Thread them through the nose of the ship.”
Shard banked “First shard banked. That's the rhythm — green feeds the ship.”
Hull warning · shards rerouted “Hull taking fire — I'm routing extra shards into your lane. Go get patched.”

Actual ticker lines from the game. The panel cycles them the way the co-pilot cycles its calls during a run.

03 · Ship Systems

Hull / Shield / Core

Three integrity systems stand between you and the void. Sentinel impacts tear them down; data shards patch them back up and recharge your boost. There is no cruise setting — speed climbs constantly, so the stream gets faster whether you're ready or not.

Hull

100% INTEGRITY

The ship's structure. When the hull is failing, the co-pilot warns you and routes repair shards into your lane.

Shield

100% INTEGRITY

The first line of defence against sentinel impacts — it takes the hit before the ship underneath does.

Core

100% INTEGRITY

The ship's heart. Keep the core alive and the run continues; lose your integrity and the co-pilot writes the debrief.

Systems Check — Try the Loop

The core loop of every run, in two buttons. Harvest a shard and watch score, repairs and boost respond; take a sentinel hit and watch the shield absorb it — then see what the co-pilot does about it.
